header: The origin narrative, with a portrait beside it
lead: Rich text in a narrative column, a captioned portrait alongside, and the founder's name and role closing the story.
bodytext:
The prose column caps at sixty-five characters a line even in the wide variant. The width field here decides how much room the picture gets, not how long the lines are — a founder story set across a full page does not get read.

The name closes the story rather than opening it. A reader is meant to arrive at the person, not to be introduced to them before there is any reason to care who they are.

The reverse toggle moves the portrait to the leading edge without touching the source order, so the narrative is still read first either way.
caption: The caption belongs to the picture, not to the story.
author: The founder's name
